lessons.claim: Re-running a translated cases/*.py regenerates its specs/ JSON with English prose and an unchanged run_id -- measured 2026-08-30 by bisecting which checker dirtied specs/. verify_l3_spec_gaps.py runs the case scripts as subprocesses, and those runs rewrite the spec. Deterministic (second run byte-matched) and verify_hash() still passes, because physics_only() strips DOC_KEYS before hashing. So the archive prose rewrite can be done by re-running the owning tool instead of hand-editing JSON, satisfying rule 2 by construction. Coverage is partial: only fields the case reconstructs.
